setup.title: Configure Trellix ePO Add-on
setup.subtitle: Configure connection settings for Trellix (McAfee) ePO server

field.label: ePO Server URL
field.name: epo_url
field.tooltip: Enter the hostname or IP address of your Trellix ePO server (e.g., epo.example.com)

field.label: ePO Server Port
field.name: epo_port
field.tooltip: Port for ePO server (default: 8443 for HTTPS)

field.label: Use SSL/TLS
field.name: use_ssl
field.tooltip: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for communication with ePO server

field.label: Verify SSL Certificate
field.name: ssl_verify
field.tooltip: Verify SSL certificate (disable only for self-signed certificates in test environments)

field.label: Authentication Method
field.name: auth_method
field.tooltip: Select authentication method: Username/Password or Token

field.label: ePO Username
field.name: epo_username
field.tooltip: Username for ePO authentication (stored securely in Splunk)

field.label: ePO Password
field.name: epo_password
field.tooltip: Password for ePO authentication (stored securely in Splunk encrypted storage)

field.label: ePO Token (Optional)
field.name: epo_token
field.tooltip: Pre-existing ePO authentication token (optional, used if auth method is Token)

field.label: Default Polling Interval (seconds)
field.name: polling_interval
field.tooltip: How often to poll ePO for new data (default: 300 seconds = 5 minutes)

field.label: Default Batch Size
field.name: batch_size
field.tooltip: Maximum number of events to retrieve per polling cycle (default: 1000)

field.label: Default Index
field.name: default_index
field.tooltip: Default Splunk index for ePO events (can be overridden per input)

field.label: Enable Incremental Collection
field.name: incremental_collection
field.tooltip: Enable checkpoint-based incremental collection to avoid duplicate events

field.label: Use Proxy
field.name: use_proxy
field.tooltip: Enable proxy server for ePO connections

field.label: Proxy Server
field.name: proxy_server
field.tooltip: Proxy server address (e.g., proxy.example.com:8080)

field.label: Proxy Username
field.name: proxy_username
field.tooltip: Username for proxy authentication (if required)

field.label: Proxy Password
field.name: proxy_password
field.tooltip: Password for proxy authentication (if required)

field.label: Checkpoint Directory
field.name: checkpoint_dir
field.tooltip: Directory to store checkpoints for incremental collection (default: ~/.splunk/checkpoints/TA-trellix-epo)

field.label: Request Timeout (seconds)
field.name: request_timeout
field.tooltip: Timeout for API requests to ePO server (default: 60 seconds)

field.label: Retry Attempts
field.name: retry_attempts
field.tooltip: Number of retry attempts for failed API requests (default: 3)

fieldset.title: Connection Test
fieldset.description: Test your ePO connection settings before saving

field.label: Test Connection
field.name: test_connection
field.tooltip: Click to test connection to ePO server with current settings

validation.name: epo_password
validation.message: ePO Password is required when using password authentication

validation.name: polling_interval
validation.message: Polling interval must be a positive number
